capability_analysis.description: Parse and navigate TypeScript source while retaining stable call-site anchors.
Classify endpoint, parameter, request and response schema changes.
Join actual repository usage to relevant vendor changes; this is the proposed proprietary value layer.
Bind findings to exact source paths and stable evidence rather than generic advice.
Re-fetch current vendor evidence and keep provenance separate from semantic relevance.
Publish a bounded pull-request warning/check through an authorized GitHub App.
Later Python support after the first TypeScript wedge.
Evaluate reusable Agent/Skill wrappers separately from product-market evidence.

delivery: Hosted CI, live Git Town sync and market pilot are not exercised by compilation
evidence: No customer-origin evidence; current evidence proves recurrence/competition only
market: No direct paid demand receipt for this product
portfolio: No admitted portfolio capability for callsite-impact-join

mvp_experiment.hypothesis: API-heavy teams will pay US$99 per repository per month when a GitHub Check identifies relevant vendor breaking changes with exact call-site evidence and less than 10% false-positive rate.
non_goals: No universal language or vendor support.
No production write access beyond an explicitly authorized GitHub Check.
No claim of market validation before paid-pilot receipts exist.
stop_loss: Stop after 10 interviews if fewer than 3 teams confirm the exact problem.
Stop or narrow the wedge if false-positive rate is 20% or higher after two bounded repair passes.
Stop if the historical replay contains fewer than 3 relevant changes.
Stop if required vendor specifications cannot be acquired under acceptable terms.
success_metrics: Interview 10 qualified teams and obtain at least 3 strong pain confirmations.
Replay at least 12 months of changes across 10 repositories and find at least 5 relevant breakages.
Keep false-positive rate below 10% on the admitted replay set.
Produce an impact report in under 5 minutes for the first TypeScript/AI-API wedge.
Obtain two paid pilots or equivalent binding commitments at the declared price.

non_claims: A compiler result is not paid demand or market validation.
A PASS code license does not grant rights to unrelated models, data, trajectories, services, patents, trademarks, or third-party content.
Portfolio matches are candidates until the owning runtime produces subject-bound equivalence evidence.
This packet does not prove hosted CI, live Git Town synchronization, merge, ship, production safety, or Human Admit.

opportunity.problem: Vendor changelogs and schema diffs are noisy; teams need to know which changed endpoint or field reaches the exact call-sites they actually use before a deployment fails.
opportunity.target_segment: API-heavy B2B SaaS teams using fast-changing AI, payments, communications, or data-provider APIs
opportunity.title: Vendor API Blast-Radius CI
opportunity.wedge: One TypeScript repository plus one AI-model API family; emit an evidence-linked GitHub Check for used endpoint and field changes without automatic repair.
